name: a-split-row-drags-down-the-list
description:
A real cgevent drag of the collapsed split row below the row under it. The split row did not drag at all before. Now it moves like an ordinary row, and one sidebarRunMoved carries every pane, so the browser moves the members as one run.

Rows 0 and 1 are clicked live and split with the message the edge drop sends. The drag starts at the split row's centre and ends on the lower edge of the Example row. Screen coordinates are the sidebar's client rectangles plus the 30px the window sits below the screen top.

actions.expression: (() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 3) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } rows[0].click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 3) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } rows[1].click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')]; if (rows.length < 2) { return 'rows ' + rows.length; } return rows.slice(0, 2).map((r) => r.dataset.tabId ? 'live' : 'cold').join(','); })()

(() => { const split = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .splitrow'); window.__cs = []; const orig = chrome.send.bind(chrome); chrome.send = (name, args) => { if (/^sidebar(Tab|Run)/.test(name) && name !== 'sidebarTabDragMoved') { window.__cs.push(name); } return orig(name, args); }; return split && split.draggable ? 'spying' : 'not draggable'; })()

(() => { const r = document.querySelector('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) .splitrow'); if (!r) { return 'none'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(b.left + b.width / 2) + ',' + Math.round(30 + b.top + b.height / 2); })()

(() => { const r = [...document.querySelectorAll('.railpane:not(.ovrailpane) [data-dropzone="tabs"] .tabrow')][1]; if (!r) { return 'none'; } const b = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(b.left + b.width / 2) + ',' + Math.round(30 + b.bottom - 3); })()
actions.note: The lower edge of the Example row, so the line goes below it.

assertions.desc: one window, so the release did not tear a pane off
both rows are live, so each carries a tab id
the split row leads the list
THE MEASUREMENT: exactly one run move, no tear-off and no split
the split row now sits below Example
